lines.gurmukhi: ਨੰਗਾ ਦੋਜਕਿ ਚਾਲਿਆ ਤਾ ਦਿਸੈ ਖਰਾ ਡਰਾਵਣਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: na(n)gaa dojak chaaliaa taa disai kharaa daraavanaa ||
lines.translation: He goes to hell naked, and he looks hideous then.
He regrets the sins he committed. ||14||
Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਇਆ ਕਪਾਹ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਸੂਤੁ ਜਤੁ ਗੰਢੀ ਸਤੁ ਵਟੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: daiaa kapaah sa(n)tokh soot jat ga(n)dhee sat vat ||
lines.translation: Make compassion the cotton, contentment the thread, modesty the knot and truth the twist.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਹੁ ਜਨੇਊ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਹਈ ਤ ਪਾਡੇ ਘਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: ehu janeoo jee kaa haee ta paade ghat ||
lines.translation: This is the sacred thread of the soul; if you have it, then go ahead and put it on me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾ ਏਹੁ ਤੁਟੈ ਨ ਮਲੁ ਲਗੈ ਨਾ ਏਹੁ ਜਲੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naa ehu tutai na mal lagai naa ehu jalai na jaai ||
lines.translation: It does not break, it cannot be soiled by filth, it cannot be burnt, or lost.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁ ਮਾਣਸ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜੋ ਗਲਿ ਚਲੇ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dha(n)n s maanas naanakaa jo gal chale paai ||
lines.translation: Blessed are those mortal beings, O Nanak, who wear such a thread around their necks.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਉਕੜਿ ਮੁਲਿ ਅਣਾਇਆ ਬਹਿ ਚਉਕੈ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: chaukaR mul anaaiaa bahi chaukai paaiaa ||
lines.translation: You buy the thread for a few shells, and seated in your enclosure, you put it on.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਖਾ ਕੰਨਿ ਚੜਾਈਆ ਗੁਰੁ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਥਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: sikhaa ka(n)n chaRaaeeaa gur braahaman thiaa ||
lines.translation: Whispering instructions into others' ears, the Brahmin becomes a guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਮੁਆ ਓਹੁ ਝੜਿ ਪਇਆ ਵੇਤਗਾ ਗਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ohu muaa ohu jhaR paiaa vetagaa gaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: But he dies, and the sacred thread falls away, and the soul departs without it. ||1||
First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਚੋਰੀਆ ਲਖ ਜਾਰੀਆ ਲਖ ਕੂੜੀਆ ਲਖ ਗਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: lakh choreeaa lakh jaareeaa lakh kooReeaa lakh gaal ||
lines.translation: He commits thousands of robberies, thousands of acts of adultery, thousands of falsehoods and thousands of abuses.

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਠਗੀਆ ਪਹਿਨਾਮੀਆ ਰਾਤਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਜੀਅ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: lakh thageeaa pahinaameeaa raat dinas jee naal ||
lines.translation: He practices thousands of deceptions and secret deeds, night and day, against his fellow beings.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਗੁ ਕਪਾਹਹੁ ਕਤੀਐ ਬਾਮੑਣੁ ਵਟੇ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tag kapaahahu kateeai baamhn vate aai ||
lines.translation: The thread is spun from cotton, and the Brahmin comes and twists it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੁਹਿ ਬਕਰਾ ਰਿੰਨੑਿ ਖਾਇਆ ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਆਖੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kuhi bakaraa ri(n)nhi khaaiaa sabh ko aakhai paai ||
lines.translation: The goat is killed, cooked and eaten, and everyone then says, "Put on the sacred thread."

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਇ ਪੁਰਾਣਾ ਸੁਟੀਐ ਭੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਹੋਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: hoi puraanaa suteeai bhee phir paaeeai hor ||
lines.translation: When it wears out, it is thrown away, and another one is put on.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਤਗੁ ਨ ਤੁਟਈ ਜੇ ਤਗਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਜੋਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak tag na tutaee je tag hovai jor ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the thread would not break, if it had any real strength. ||2||
First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਪਤਿ ਊਪਜੈ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਸੂਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: naai ma(n)niai pat oopajai saalaahee sach soot ||
lines.translation: Believing in the Name, honor is obtained. The Lord's Praise is the true sacred thread.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਰਗਹ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਤਗੁ ਨ ਤੂਟਸਿ ਪੂਤ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: daragah a(n)dar paaeeai tag na tootas poot ||3||
lines.translation: Such a sacred thread is worn in the Court of the Lord; it shall never break. ||3||
First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਗੁ ਨ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਤਗੁ ਨ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: tag na i(n)dree tag na naaree ||
lines.translation: There is no sacred thread for the sexual organ, and no thread for woman.
The man's beard is spat upon daily.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਗੁ ਨ ਪੈਰੀ ਤਗੁ ਨ ਹਥੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: tag na pairee tag na hathee ||
lines.translation: There is no sacred thread for the feet, and no thread for the hands;

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਗੁ ਨ ਜਿਹਵਾ ਤਗੁ ਨ ਅਖੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: tag na jihavaa tag na akhee ||
lines.translation: no thread for the tongue, and no thread for the eyes.
The Brahmin himself goes to the world hereafter without a sacred thread.
Twisting the threads, he puts them on others.
He takes payment for performing marriages;
reading their horoscopes, he shows them the way.
Hear, and see, O people, this wondrous thing.
He is mentally blind, and yet his name is wisdom. ||4||
Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਸਾਈ ਕਾਰ ਕਰਾਇਸੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: saahib hoi daiaal kirapaa kare taa saaee kaar karaaisee ||
lines.translation: One, upon whom the Merciful Lord bestows His Grace, performs His service.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮਨਾਇਸੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: so sevak sevaa kare jis no hukam manaaisee ||
lines.translation: That servant, whom the Lord causes to obey the Order of His Will, serves Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਮੰਨਿਐ ਹੋਵੈ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਤਾ ਖਸਮੈ ਕਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਇਸੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: hukam ma(n)niai hovai paravaan taa khasamai kaa mahal paaisee ||
lines.translation: Obeying the Order of His Will, he becomes acceptable, and then, he obtains the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਸਮੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਮਨਹੁ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਸੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: khasamai bhaavai so kare manahu chi(n)diaa so phal paaisee ||
lines.translation: One who acts to please His Lord and Master, obtains the fruits of his mind's desires.
Then, he goes to the Court of the Lord, wearing robes of honor. ||15||
Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਊ ਬਿਰਾਹਮਣ ਕਉ ਕਰੁ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਗੋਬਰਿ ਤਰਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gaoo biraahaman kau kar laavahu gobar taran na jaaee ||
lines.translation: They tax the cows and the Brahmins, but the cow-dung they apply to their kitchen will not save them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੋਤੀ ਟਿਕਾ ਤੈ ਜਪਮਾਲੀ ਧਾਨੁ ਮਲੇਛਾਂ ਖਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhotee tikaa tai japamaalee dhaan malechhaa(n) khaaee ||
lines.translation: They wear their loin cloths, apply ritual frontal marks to their foreheads, and carry their rosaries, but they eat food with the Muslims.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪੂਜਾ ਪੜਹਿ ਕਤੇਬਾ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਤੁਰਕਾ ਭਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar poojaa paRahi katebaa sa(n)jam turakaa bhaaee ||
lines.translation: O Siblings of Destiny, you perform devotional worship indoors, but read the Islamic sacred texts, and adopt the Muslim way of life.
Renounce your hypocrisy!
Taking the Naam, the Name of the Lord, you shall swim across. ||1||
First Mehl:
The man-eaters say their prayers.
Those who wield the knife wear the sacred thread around their necks.
In their homes, the Brahmins sound the conch.
They too have the same taste.
False is their capital, and false is their trade.
Speaking falsehood, they take their food.
The home of modesty and Dharma is far from them.
O Nanak, they are totally permeated with falsehood.
The sacred marks are on their foreheads, and the saffron loin-cloths are around their waists;
in their hands they hold the knives - they are the butchers of the world!
